sections.text: Drop files or analysis folders below
sections.description: Drag and drop TTTR files, BID/BUR/BST files, or burst analysis folders (bi4_bur). Checked files are used.

columns.label: File
columns.description: A TTTR file, a .bur burst table, or a burst-analysis folder.

columns.label: Folder
columns.description: Where it is; the whole path is shown under the list for the selected entry.

context_menu.label: Delete selected
context_menu.description: Remove this entry from the list.

context_menu.label: Clear all
context_menu.description: Remove every entry from the list.

sections.description: The files a read takes: a .bur table reads the bursts it names, a folder its tables, a TTTR file with a bi4_bur folder beside it is read burst-wise.

Three colours: the excitation-window check of the measurement just added. The two micro-time windows (the blue and the green excitation period of the PIE cycle) do not hold its excitation pulses, so photons would be counted under the wrong excitation; the windows detected in the data are named.
Take the excitation periods detected in the data.

buttons.label: Use detected windows
buttons.description: Write the excitation periods detected in this measurement into the two micro-time windows, earliest first. The saved setup is not changed.

buttons.label: Load dropped files
buttons.description: Read checked TTTR files using current PDA settings.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Clear all dropped files from the list.
